concept.title: Defrosting the outside of the windshield

keywords.indexterm: windshield defrosting and defogging defrosting the outside of the windshield

section.title: For manual climate control system
section.p: To defrost the outside of the windshield using the manual climate control system, follow these steps:

li.p: Set the fan to its highest speed.
Set the temperature to maximum heat.

section.title: For automatic climate control system
section.p: To defrost the outside of the windshield using the automatic climate control system, follow these steps:

li.p: Set the fan to its highest speed.
Set the temperature to maximum heat.
External airflow is selected automatically, and the air conditioner (A/C) operates according to the detected ambient temperature.
